# Task template

Copy into TASKS with the next coordinator-allocated TASK-NNN ID.

```text
## TASK-NNN — Observable outcome
Status: planned | in progress | blocked | in review | done | canceled
Owner / reviewer: actual assigned identities or unassigned
Authorization: exact current instruction; allowed actions/targets and exclusions
Packet / source IDs: WP, FR/D, AC, G/F as relevant
Inputs: canonical docs and accepted producer artifact/interface revisions
Dependencies / unblock condition: concrete, not assumed
Permitted paths / shared-file writer: explicit; exclude .repo and unrelated work
Deliverables: bounded observable artifacts/behavior
Done checks: meaningful success, invalid/failure/race and documentation boundaries
Checks run: exact commands/versions/results or not run + reason
Evidence / review: links, actual disposition, remaining limits
Next action: precise resumable step
```
